owner_direction: Infer values using circuit function, resistances, reference designs and RF requirements; avoid measuring all 40-plus capacitors.

sources.title: ABLIC S-1200, Rev.6 p10: input/output capacitance and ESR
sources.finding: Candidate U1 permits input and output capacitance >=0.1 uF; output ESR <=1 ohm. This is a design constraint, not the PetSafe BOM.

sources.title: ABLIC S-812C, Rev.7 p18: output capacitor purpose
sources.finding: Candidate U6 can be stable without an output capacitor; the capacitor improves transient response. It does not force C37 to a particular value.

sources.title: SGMICRO SGM8542, pp9-10: bypassing and low-pass feedback
sources.finding: The example supply network uses 10 uF plus 0.1 uF (or 0.01 uF). The inverting feedback example gives gain -Rf/Rin and a pole 1/(2*pi*Rf*C). No exact PetSafe receiver reference schematic is established.

sources.title: Microchip 8-bit PIC design recommendations
sources.finding: Recommends 100 nF local VDD/VSS bypassing. Warns that MCLR capacitance can affect programming; do not blindly assign C35 as a generic debounce capacitor.

sources.title: TI SN74LVC2G14 candidate datasheet
sources.finding: Reference for candidate U2 input thresholds and supply limits; candidate identity remains unresolved at the measured 6.3-V supply. No assumed threshold used to finalize C8/C9.

sources.title: Microchip AN710: Antenna Circuit Design
sources.finding: Resonant antenna design depends on inductance and the equivalent capacitance/loading, not frequency alone.

sources.title: PetSafe Microchip Cat Flap family: FDX-B information
sources.finding: FDX-B family information supports 134.2 kHz as a working hypothesis; this is not a measured carrier or exact PPA19-16811 electronics specification.

sources.title: Murata capacitor selection guide
sources.finding: Capacitance, dielectric, voltage and size are separate selection parameters. Package dimensions alone do not recover the capacitance.

sources.title: Murata: capacitance under DC bias
sources.finding: High-permittivity ceramics can lose effective capacitance under DC bias; qualify effective capacitance at the operating rail when selecting replacements.

principles: These are design proposals and constraints, not proof of the original factory BOM. No reference schematic matching the entire board has been established.

Use X7R/X5R candidates for general reservoir/bypass work with effective capacitance checked under bias. C0G/NP0 is a useful low-loss starting dielectric for small timing/filter candidates; actual dielectric is unconfirmed.

The 6.3-V observed supply is not a rating ceiling: supply replacements can start with 16-V candidates, but motor transients and antenna resonant voltages require separate qualification. No universal 16-V antenna rating is asserted.
Package size alone cannot distinguish pF, nF or uF. Existing 0805 C30/C31 are crystal loads; the large 1206 tuning bank may prioritize dielectric loss and AC voltage rather than capacitance.
Unknown-value count stays 44. No automatic native replacement, no new scope batch and no desoldering request.

calculations.resonance_frequency_status: 134.2-kHz working hypothesis from product-family FDX-B information, not measured on this PCB
calculations.caveat: Simple LC examples bound an equivalent total, not the fifteen physical capacitor values. Winding resistance near 5 ohm cannot determine inductance.

next_actions: Review the 12 supply starting values as provisional reconstruction choices; no measurement of each bypass is needed now.
Use C21/C22 trial range in receiver analysis, preserving raw auto-mode readings.
When scope work resumes, a carrier/resonance check and receiver response constrain several capacitor values at once.

An antenna inductance measurement is useful only if the winding can be electrically separated from the board without violating the fitted-components constraint; no fitted across-ANT1/ANT2 reading is treated as coil inductance.
Do not assign individual antenna weights or copy unrelated RFID reference values without matching inductance and switch topology.
